decisionsTitle: The members' zone opens on «Alergări», each run with «Cine vine» open and the next run first (amending §715, §812)
decisionsSection:
**The owner, 2026-10-19,** after «„Cine vine" trebuie să fie mai vizibil» and the name switch: «And it should be a lot easier for BVR members to see this.» The dispatcher's reading: a signed-in member of Brașov Runners sees who is coming to the next runs without looking for it.

**Decision (no new rule: an order and a place).**

1. **The zone opens on «Alergări»** (amends §715). The tabs' order is «Alergări» · «Coduri de reducere» · «Magazin». «Alergări» is the zone's own address, `/members-area` (`/zona-membri`), so the sign-in's landing (`?to=members`), the members' page's button and the backoffice's bounce all arrive at the runs. The codes move to `/members-area/codes` (`/zona-membri/coduri`); the shop stays at `/members-area/shop`. The old `/members-area/runs` (`/zona-membri/alergari`) is kept as a permanent redirect (308) to the zone that carries only `?vin=` (the code of what a press said), so no link made before breaks and a page left open on the old address still lands on its sentence; the anchor is the browser's own and survives it. The press's Server Actions redirect to `/members-area` directly. The phone's short tab words (§731) follow the order. No tab is hidden or shown differently: «Magazin» still waits for the notice that names it (§683).

2. **Each run's card shows who is coming, open** (amends §812). In «Alergări» every run is a card: its title as the link to its page, its day, «Vin!» / «Tu vii ✓ · Nu mai vin» with the name tick (§822, §827; its help line says the name shows on the run's page and under «Cine vine») and, directly under them, **«Cine vine (N)»** with the names of those who ticked and «și încă N» — a heading and a list, always showing, not a fold (the event page keeps its fold, §825). It is `RsvpCount` with an `open` prop — the same bar, glyph, rows and «și încă N» — never a second component; its heading is an `h4`, one level under the run's title, and its region is named by both. A run nobody has answered draws no list: the row above it already says «Fii primul care spune că vine.». The names come from the public read (`readPublicRsvps` through the cache), **gathered once for the page** (`readPublicRsvpsFor`: the notice's version once and each offered run's cached read in parallel, never a read per card).

3. **The next run first and larger.** The soonest run that takes answers is the first card, on the lead event's frame (`featuredCard`, §470), with a larger title — the frame and the title are the only visible marks, no chip and no overline (the owner, 2026-10-16, on the listing's lead card), and «Următoarea alergare» is said to a screen reader only, before the title's link — so a member who opens the zone reads «Luni, 18:30 · 12 vin · Tu vii ✓» at a glance; the others follow by date. It is chosen among every upcoming run, not only the five the page lists: the soonest run that takes answers is drawn (and answered for) even when the five before it take none. With no run taking answers, nothing is featured and the order is the date's. The members' events section moves under the runs.

**The disclosure does not move** (§143, §812, unchanged): a name shows only for a confirmed answer whose person ticked, under a notice version that describes «Vin!»; being a member, or a colleague opening the zone, widens nothing — showing members the names of people who did not tick would be a new disclosure the notice does not describe.

**Refused.** Names for members beyond the ticked ones (a new disclosure). A second list component for the zone. A read per card. Keeping the codes first and a «Cine vine» fold under each run (the owner's complaint was the fold). Two addresses for the runs with the same content (the old one redirects). Featuring the soonest run whether or not it takes answers (the card's point is who comes).
changelogLine: - **The members' zone opens on «Alergări»** — the tabs are «Alergări», «Coduri de reducere», «Magazin»; each run shows «Vin!» and «Cine vine (N)» open (the names of those who ticked, «și încă N»), and the next run that takes answers is the first, larger card. The codes moved to their own address; the old runs address redirects. §NNN.

specsCriteria.text: Amends criterion 211: the members' zone shows its tabs in the order «Alergări», «Coduri de reducere», «Magazin», each part at its own address, and «Alergări» is the zone's own address (`/zona-membri`), where the sign-in, the members' page and the backoffice's bounce arrive; the codes are at `/zona-membri/coduri`, and the old `/zona-membri/alergari` is a permanent redirect to the zone that keeps only `?vin=` (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

Given the members' zone's «Alergări» with runs that take answers, when it renders, then each such run's card shows «Cine vine (N)» open — a heading and a list, never a fold — with the names of those who ticked and «și încă N» for the rest, read once for the whole page; a name appears only under the public rule (a confirmed answer whose person ticked, under a notice that describes «Vin!»), for a member and a colleague alike, and the soonest such run is the first, featured card (2026-10-19, `DECISIONS.md` §NNN).

batchLine: the members' zone opens on «Alergări»: each run with «Vin!» and who is coming, the next run first
